caption: This ramen features a rich amber, glossy miso broth with froth and visible noodles and toppings. A whole boiled egg, tender chashu pork, and a white ceramic bowl on a light brown wooden table complete the scene.

segments_info.text: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, oval-shaped surface.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, slightly fatty texture with browned edges and visible marbling, irregularly shaped.
A whole boiled egg, pale yellowish-white, smooth and glossy, oval-shaped with subtle surface variations.
The miso broth is rich amber, glossy, and frothy, with visible noodles and toppings partially submerged.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, subtly textured rim.
